Categories.value: Sitting Bull|Black Elk|Diego Angeli|PD Italy (20 years after creation)|Images with annotations|Buffalo Bill's Wild West|PD-1996|Template Unknown (author)|1890 in Rome|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|February 1890 Italy photographs|Antico Caffè Greco - Interior|Historical images of Italy uploaded by LucaLindholm

ImageDescription.value:
Buffalo Bill, Black Elk and the Italian journalist and writer Diego Angeli at the "Antico Caffè Greco" in Rome, Italy, 24 February 1890, during the Italian tour of the Buffalo's Wild West Show.

The cafè is still running today and is still in Via dei Condotti n.86.

Info and original image source: "Le cronache del Caffè Greco. Con 19 illustrazioni", by Diego Angeli, Treves Editior, 1930. [1]
